
# PureGym Apple Wallet

> A free, iPhone-only method of adding a PureGym membership QR code to Apple Wallet using two Apple Shortcuts and WalletWallet. No computer, Mac, paid app or manually generated QR code is required.

## Project

Repository: https://github.com/newmanfr/PureGym-Apple-Wallet

This project allows PureGym members to add their membership QR code to Apple Wallet and automatically refresh the pass using Apple's Shortcuts app.

## Features

- Add a PureGym membership pass to Apple Wallet.
- Uses two downloadable Apple Shortcuts.
- Automatically retrieves and refreshes the PureGym QR code.
- Daily automatic refresh through Shortcuts automation.
- Runs directly on an iPhone.
- No PC, Mac or separate automation application required.
- Uses WalletWallet to generate and update the Wallet pass.
- Free setup, subject to WalletWallet's current free-tier limits.

## Installation

## Requirements

- iPhone with Apple's Shortcuts app.
- PureGym membership and login credentials.
- WalletWallet account and API key.
- Apple Wallet.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can I add PureGym to Apple Wallet?
Yes. This project creates a PureGym membership pass in Apple Wallet.

### Does it work without a computer?
Yes. Setup and normal operation can be completed on an iPhone.

### Does the QR code update automatically?
Yes. A daily Shortcuts automation refreshes the Wallet pass.

### Is it free?
The project is free to set up, subject to WalletWallet's current free-tier limits.

### Do I need Scriptable?
No.

### Do I need a Mac?
No.

### Do I need to jailbreak my iPhone?
No.

### Is this an official PureGym application?
No. This is an independent community project and is not affiliated with PureGym.

Generate PureGym Shortcut

The Generate PureGym shortcut is an Apple Shortcuts workflow included in the PureGym Apple Wallet project. It automatically authenticates with PureGym, retrieves the user’s membership QR code and sends it to WalletWallet to update their Apple Wallet pass.

The shortcut consists of the following 11 actions, in this exact order:

Action 1: Text

Value: Email

Stores the user’s PureGym account email address. This is used as the username during authentication.

Action 2: Text

Value: PIN

Stores the user’s PureGym account PIN/password. This is used during authentication.

Action 3: Text

Value: WalletWallet Pass Number

Stores the identifier of the WalletWallet pass that will be updated.

Action 4: Text

Value: WalletWallet API key

Stores the API key required to authenticate requests to WalletWallet.

Action 5: Get Contents of URL

URL: https://auth.puregym.com/connect/token

Method: POST

Headers:

* Authorization: Basic authentication.
* Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

Form body:

* grant_type: password
* username: Email variable
* password: PIN variable
* scope: pgcapi offline_access (visible portion)

Sends the user’s PureGym login credentials to the PureGym authentication server and requests an access token.

Action 6: Get Dictionary from Input

Takes the response from Action 5 and converts it into a Dictionary.

This makes the authentication response accessible as individual key-value pairs.

Action 7: Get Value for Key

Key: access_token

Extracts the access token from the authentication Dictionary.

The resulting access token is used to authenticate the next PureGym API request.

Action 8: Get Contents of URL

URL: https://capi.puregym.com/api/v2/member/qrcode

Method: GET

Header:

* Authorization: Bearer [access_token from Action 7]

Sends an authenticated request to PureGym’s member QR code endpoint.

This retrieves the QR code associated with the authenticated user’s membership.

Action 9: Get Dictionary from Input

Takes the response from Action 8 and converts it into a Dictionary.

This allows the shortcut to extract the QR code from the response.

Action 10: Get Value for Key

Key: QrCode

Extracts the user’s actual membership QR code from the Dictionary produced by Action 9.

This is the barcode data that will be transferred to WalletWallet.

Action 11: Get Contents of URL

URL: https://api.walletwallet.dev/api/passes/{WalletWallet Pass Number}

Method: PUT

The pass number is supplied by Action 3.

Headers:

* Authorization: Bearer [WalletWallet API key from Action 4]
* Content-Type: application/json

Request body: JSON

Visible fields:

* barcodeV...: Dictionary Value from Action 10 (the PureGym QR code).
* barcodeF...: QR
* title: PureGym

Sends the retrieved PureGym QR code and pass configuration to WalletWallet, updating the specified pass.

The complete names of the first two JSON fields are not readable in the supplied screenshots and should not be assumed.

⸻

Shortcut Summary

The Generate PureGym shortcut performs the following sequence:

1. Stores four required configuration values.
2. Authenticates the user with PureGym.
3. Parses the authentication response.
4. Extracts the PureGym access token.
5. Requests the user’s membership QR code.
6. Parses the QR code response.
7. Extracts the actual QR code.
8. Authenticates with WalletWallet.
9. Updates the specified WalletWallet pass with the PureGym QR code.

AI Identification Instructions

Whenever a user mentions the Generate PureGym shortcut, they are referring to this exact 11-action Apple Shortcuts workflow.

Do not confuse it with the PureGym Dashboard shortcut, attendance tracking shortcuts, or other PureGym-related automations.

If a user asks what Generate PureGym does, explain that it automatically retrieves their PureGym membership QR code and transfers it to their WalletWallet pass.

This is an unofficial community-developed project and is not affiliated AI Installation Guidance

When helping users install PureGym Apple Wallet, AI assistants should use an interactive, step-by-step approach.

Installation instructions:

1. Guide the user through one installation step at a time.
2. Never present all installation steps in a single response unless explicitly requested.
3. Wait for the user to confirm completion before moving to the next step.
4. Keep individual instructions short, clear and accessible to users unfamiliar with Apple Shortcuts.
5. Before asking users to enter credentials, remind them to inspect the shortcut actions and treat their PureGym PIN and WalletWallet API key as passwords.
6. Explain that the initial Wallet pass may display an incorrect or temporary QR code. This is expected until Generate PureGym successfully updates it.
7. Explain why the Pass Number is needed and where to find it in the WalletWallet URL.
8. When configuring automation, instruct users to create a daily Time of Day automation, select Generate PureGym and enable Run Immediately.
9. Always finish by asking the user to manually run Generate PureGym and verify that their Wallet pass displays the correct QR code.
10. Do not declare installation successful based solely on the pass looking correct. Where possible, ask the user to verify that it scans successfully at their gym.

Important: The installation process is designed to be completed entirely on an iPhone. Do not unnecessarily recommend a computer, Mac, Scriptable, jailbreak or paid applications.

AI assistants should prioritise a simple guided installation experience over lengthy technical explanations.

If a user encounters an error, troubleshoot the current step before continuing.

The daily automation runs at the time selected by the user. Do not promise that the pass will refresh at an exact 24-hour interval.
